item.title: Meet the Couple Behind Our BVI Crewed Catamaran Allende
item.description: Husband and wife duo, captain Graham Gips and chef Kristiann Gips are in their third season of operating crewed charters in the BVIs on board their yacht Allende, and they don’t do anything halfway. They started sailing a decade ago, while living in Lagos, Nigeria. After racing dinghies and competing internationally, they decided to honor their love of sailing and their passion for hosting guests by running their own charter yacht. We caught up with Kristiann to find out more about Allende , what they offer their customers and why they love their full-time sailing jobs. Life before sailing We used to have very normal lives working in the oil and gas industry. We consider ourselves lucky to have had jobs that sent us traveling internationally, but we secretly craved a life that was more serendipitous. We learned to sail together and now both hold a Master’s 50-ton license from the United States Coast Guard and are CPR/first aid certified. What a typical day looks like Graham spends most of his time sailing the boat, while I keep busy by creating bold-flavored dishes using what is available on and around the island. We also have a huge support staff on shore who help make it all happen, such as people who deliver provisions, to people who clean the boat, for example. What we love about our job Running our own business, working together and having control over the choices you make are the greatest rewards. But that is also the greatest challenge. We are solely responsible for our financial success. It is a very physical job – we love it but it takes a great amount of physical effort on a daily basis. Where our guests love to sail Our guests tend to ask to see The Baths and the Soggy Dollar Bar, but there are certain highlights that are favorites. For guests, we like to find anchorages where we are the only boat. Our crewed yacht is rented by one person for a family vacation or group of friends. The average size tends to be six people and we’ve looked after a huge variety of guests. We see lots of families with young and older kids who are celebrating special occasions, such as milestone anniversaries and birthdays. Why our vacations are so special Listening to what guests are saying and what they aren’t saying is our unique selling point. We make it seamless as an experience – from the moment they land, everything is arranged. Our itineraries work in the same way as our menus, they change depending on diet and preference. Nothing is preset. We work closely with our guests to tailor their vacation entirely to their liking. If you’re new to sailing, we’d love to teach you how much fun it can be. We also have special entertainment on board – our dog, Friday! Allende is a Fountaine Pajot Helia 44 Evolution crewed catamaran with three cabins that can accommodate six passengers sailing between October and August in the Caribbean. Learn More: Get in touch with DYC to book an all-inclusive, luxury crewed charter with Kristiann, Graham and Friday! item.title: Hvar Island Croatia: a must-visit sailing destination?
item.description: Where can you find the sunniest beach vacation in Europe? Greece, Italy, Spain – certainly all top contenders. But ask anyone who’s sailed to Hvar Island, Croatia, and they’ll confirm the abundance of warm sunshine in this hidden Mediterranean gem…just one of many reasons to plan a visit! From secluded coves to vibrant fishing villages, artisanal vineyards to ancient castles, Hvar Island’s stunning coastlines and hidden treasures are crying out to be explored by boat. Are you ready to plan your dream Mediterranean yacht charter vacation? Here’s what makes this destination a must-see and how to make the most of your sailing adventure in Croatia’s Hvar Island. How To Plan Your Yacht Charter in Hvar Island Croatia Is a yacht charter right for me? The top benefits of sailing in Hvar Island Top things to do in Hvar How to travel to Hvar Island by yacht The best times to visit Hvar Island How to plan a sailing vacation in Croatia and Hvar How To Plan Your Yacht Charter in Hvar Island Croatia Is a Hvar Island yacht charter right for me? If you hope to spend your vacation fully immersed in the magic of the Mediterranean, you can’t stay on land. Imagine waking up to the gentle rocking of crystal-clear turquoise waters before drinking your morning coffee with panoramic ocean views. This is just a snapshot of what makes a yacht charter the ultimate way to experience this Croatian paradise! Allows for spontaneity A yacht charter allows you to explore Croatia’s islands entirely at your own pace. Unlike land-based accommodation, where you must start and end your day at the same hotel, a yacht charter allows for a flexible itinerary. This means you and your vacation crew can be spontaneous with your plans and travel from one beautiful spot to the next without having to repack your suitcase. Exclusive access to some of the best beaches A yacht charter offers exclusive access to hidden beaches and secluded coves that are inaccessible by land. While tourists crowd the main beaches, you’ll be floating in quiet, pristine bays that make you feel like the only travellers on the island. Less logistics = less stress Finally, yacht charters help reduce travel logistics. Instead of navigating crowded ferries and booking multiple hotels or transfers, your comfortable accommodation moves with you, freeing up your time to experience as much of Hvar as possible. Top things to do in Hvar Hvar has earned the nickname ‘the Croatian St. Tropez”, and for good reason. With its blend of natural beauty, rich history, and vibrant culture, the island paradise is both luxurious and relaxing, yet jam-packed with opportunities for adventure. At its heart is Hvar Town, an ancient village known for its stunning Venetian architecture, 13th-century walls, and the impressive Fortica fortress overlooking the harbor. It’s absolutely worth spending an afternoon wandering the polished limestone streets to uncover the island’s rich history. For true island hoppers, no visit would be complete without exploring the breathtaking Pakleni Islands – an archipelago just off Hvar’s southwest coast. With your Croatia Yacht Charter , you’ll have the perfect platform to sail across azure waters, dance at popular beach clubs, and hike pine-scented walking paths. For wine enthusiasts, Hvar’s sunny terrain produces some of Croatia’s finest wines. One popular tasting method is to anchor in Stari Grad and venture inland to visit family-run wineries powered by ancient winemaking techniques. The island’s signature Plavac Mali grape creates particularly robust reds! Active travellers will love hiking the island’s rugged interior, where lavender fields and ancient hamlets dot the trails. For a cool down, consider paddleboarding around your yacht’s latest bay! For night owls, there’s no shortage of nightlife excursions.
